resources.string:
Hello from Party UP! version %s

This app lets you upload files (images, videos) to a copyparty server.

Use your favorite gallery app to open a picture or video you\'d like to upload, then hit the share button and select \"Party UP!\" 🎉

You can also share things like YouTube videos; the app will then upload a message with the link. The copyparty server can be configured to log these for later viewing.

Fun fact: You can run the copyparty server itself on any device where Python is available — and thanks to Termux this also means Android phones :^)

To upload into a folder, add the folder at the end of the URL.
For example: "https://ask.com/foo/bar/"
Example: "https://ask.com/%Y/%m/" will create
"/Year/month/" (%Y/%m/%d, %H:%M:%S)

If server has enabled login using usernames, input "<username>:<password>",
For example: azure:hunter2

Long-press to reveal the password
Invalid format. Use: 30m, 2h, 7d, or empty for never
